product.description: an Optec spotlight on ERCO's DALI 220-240 V track with a narrow spot Spherolit lens, 3000 K CRI 92, DALI-2 control gear in the fitting, white (RAL 9002); its head under the Cube's soffit ring
product.codeBasis: the maker's data sheet 75995.000 (edition 28.04.2026, version 7), read: Optec Spotlight, Spherolit lens narrow spot, LED module 6.2 W 725 lm 3000 K warm white, DALI-2

light.fluxBasis: luminaire: the data sheet's luminous flux of the luminaire (the 6.2 W LED module gives 725 lm)

electrical.control: DALI-2: ERCO DALI control gear in the fitting, addressed over the DALI track, dimmed by constant current reduction 1 to 100 %
electrical.mounting: ERCO DALI track, Hi-trac DALI track or DALI singlet

housing.dimensionBasis: the data sheet's drawing: the head d 105, and 159, 176 and 70 unlabelled in its text layer
housing.materials: cylindrical light head of powder-coated cast aluminium; housing of polymer; collimating lens of optical polymer
housing.mounting: ERCO DALI track, Hi-trac DALI track or DALI singlet

photometricFile.note: ERCO publishes an IES and LDT file per article at the article's page; the data sheet's cone diagram and illuminance table (29 001 lx at 1 m under a cone of 6.1 degrees, 0.11 m across) are what the record is lit by.

sources.title: ERCO, data sheet 75995.000 Optec Spotlight, narrow spot, 3000 K CRI 92, DALI-2, edition 28.04.2026 (642 lm, Imax 29 001 cd, cone 6.1 degrees, 8.7 W, 0.73 kg)

ERCO, data sheet A1014621 Parscan 48V Spotlight, size M, narrow spot, 3000 K CRI 97, edition 28.04.2026 (299 lm, Imax 23 631 cd, cone 4.4 degrees, 6.0 W): the narrower Parscan, set aside because its control is On-board Dim, a rotary control on the fitting that no presence sensor or channel can switch
ERCO, Parscan 48V (product page): On-board Dim or Casambi Bluetooth; no Casambi narrow spot article at 3000 K was found among the published data sheets

unverified: The cone of 6.1 degrees is read as the beam angle (half the peak): the data sheet's table gives it 0.11 m across at 1 m with the peak illuminance at its centre; ERCO's symbols page defining the cone was not read.

The Cube's sheet asks for a 5 degree beam with a 2 degree core; the maker's narrow spot is 6.1 degrees, which the record keeps: at the 12.46 m throw it spreads 1.33 m, so it still ends on the car (its guides at r 2.29).
